mapping_evidence: Separated demonstration and matching impact count; see segments.json for evidence and alternative mapping.

weapon.type: Broad rectangular greatsword/slab blade, visually confirmed; no separate physical tower shield resolved.
weapon.parts: Broad squared/beveled tip, thick pale metallic perimeter, dark inset central panel, small yellow-green rectangular inset near base, dark grip/guard. Edge-on views can look like a rod.
weapon.grip: Both gauntleted hands appear clustered on/near grip in sweep close-ups; overhead poses visibly have both arms raised. Hand overlap and motion blur prevent finger-level grip identification.
weapon.held_positions: Low diagonal blade pointing behind/left during ready pose; broad blade behind shoulder during sweep follow-through; raised behind/above head for slams.
weapon.limitations: Dimensions and hex values are estimates from compressed video. Large apparent size changes mostly come from camera punches, not weapon growth.
weapon.skill_specific: Two waist/shoulder-level sweeps. Physical metal surface meeting target is hidden by crop/glow; do not assert edge-cutting or replace official Blunt with Slash.

props.description: No detached blade, projectile, summoned weapon or shield. Gold crescents are weapon-associated VFX, not separately tracked objects.

caster_motion.description: Low ready, slight settling/lean; camera closes in.
Sweep and follow-through, mostly planted feet; no resolved traveling dash.
Low blade reset then torso turns into second sweep.
Second sweep; caster left of target after camera widens.
Low extended stance held until cut.

hits.contact_observation: First visible impact flash/spark proxy; physical contact may be occluded.
hits.what_makes_contact: Held-weapon sweep / gold trail at target side; exact metal-to-body contact cropped.
hits.distance_method: Estimate from adjacent readable two-shot; cropped contact itself may not permit measurement.

evidence.description: Orange-white impact appears at right edge while sword remains with caster.

hits.contact_observation: First visible impact flash/spark proxy; physical contact may be occluded.
hits.what_makes_contact: Held-weapon horizontal sweep with bright chest-height streak; exact contact hidden by close-up.
hits.distance_method: Estimate from adjacent readable two-shot; cropped contact itself may not permit measurement.

evidence.description: New orange impact after torn yellow motion smear; subsequent target recoil.

beats.description: First low-ready blade pose; brief hold while camera approaches.
One-frame onset of gold arc behind/above caster.
Orange impact at 359; wide elevated crescent and waist streak hold, then thin. Not multiple hits.
Sword returns low; no new impact.
394 ring/smear; 395 almost all yellow torn stroke with caster cropped on right.
396 cropped torso with orange impact; 397 tighter white/orange horizontal flare.
398 head/torso, 399–400 wider view of oval sweep.
Single second-hit ring holds then breaks into streaks.
Gold disappears; low blade pose held until wide cut at 427.

effects.position: Encircling caster at waist/hip level; low portion near feet

conventions: Zero-based source frame indices; intervals are [start,end). Seconds use decoded PTS, not rounded sheet labels. Nominal 30 fps has millisecond PTS rounding.
limitations: Contact proxy is the first impact spark/flash, not verified game damage timing. Cropping and opaque VFX hide some physical contacts; uncertainty intervals are recorded. Camera and effect event boundaries refer to observed source frames.

H = visible upright character height, excluding weapon/hair overshoot. Distances, effect dimensions and colors are visual estimates, not calibrated world coordinates. Do not treat zoom-induced apparent displacement as a dash.

Classify motion/contact, not long bright streak shape alone. Sweeps here stay tied to a held weapon; no detached traveling projectile or sustained beam is resolved. Their oversized trails bridge stylized sprite spacing. Melee classifications for cropped contacts have medium confidence.
